note: Committable. Contains no machine-specific paths and no secret values. Regenerate with `mcp_lock.py generate`; check in CI with `mcp_lock.py verify`.

resolutionSnapshot.note: the registry state this lock resolved against. Integrity hashes pin what you get; this pins the shape of the tree, which a new transitive release changes without changing any existing hash. Replay with `mcp_lock.py generate <config> <out> --from-snapshot <file>`.

fetch.note: PyPI requirement markers are environment-dependent; root pinned only

git.note: PyPI requirement markers are environment-dependent; root pinned only

remote.note: remote server: no local install, nothing to pin. The endpoint is recorded so a change to it is visible in review.

grafana.reason: mutable image tag; pin to a sha256 digest to lock this server

localdev.reason: local executable (node); nothing in a registry to pin
